title: Matt Ryan sees "untapped potential" in Jahan Dotson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt Ryan sees "untapped potential" in Jahan Dotson
sources.description: Falcons president of football Matt Ryan isn't quite sure what to expect from the team's quarterbacks once the team gets to training camp this summer, but he seems to have a bit more certainty when it comes to one of the team's offseason additions.
